sources.text: News Seminars Publications People Wiki Contact Us Lecture at Nobel Symposium at Chalmers University, Sweden, highlights importance of NIH funding in drug discovery for infectious disease. Andy McCammon Speaker: Watch on YouTube White House plans to vet public grants for ‘American values’ spark broad alarm article: The Guardian “The proposed federal legislation that will by-pass peer review of scientific grant proposals in favor of political oversight, allow grants to be terminated at any time, for any reason, and largely prevent the use of federal funds for publishing, attending meetings, or collaborating internationally would be another devastating blow to American science,” wrote Andy McCammon, a chemistry research professor at the University of California San Diego and member of the editorial board of the National Academy of Sciences. Computational Research in Molecular Chemistry Login Recent News August 2026 Novel treatments for Parkinson’s Disease , developed with computational help from our group High school student Gavin Ni (La Jolla Country Day School), who conducted MD simulations of the Damage Suppressor) protein from the tardigrade organism, will begin undergraduate work at Harvard in the fall. July 2026 The McCammon group contributed to new research on Parkinson’s Disease, published July 15 in Science Translational Medicine: “A small molecule reduces both parkinsonism and l-dopa–induced dyskinesia in animal models of Parkinson’s disease”, Vol. 18, DOI 10.1126/scitranslmed.aec740 (2026). Former graduate student Bill Sinko published in PNAS a new computational package for free energy calculations in drug discovery, based in part on his graduate work: “ModBinddG: A simulation- based absolute predictor of free energy of binding based on population reweighting”, PNAS Vol. 123, e2513285123 (2026). June 2026 Undergraduate researcher Praharshitha Thumati completed her undergraduate work at UCSD with honors in Biochemistry (B.S.) and in Japanese Studies (B.A.). Former undergraduate researcher Daniel Dadon (Ph.D., MIT) is now on the Scientific Advisory Board at Elektrofi in San Diego. March 2026 Former postdoc Giulia Palermo has accepted a Full Professorship at UCLA , starting July 1, 2026. She joins two other former group members in UCLA’s Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry, Steffen Lindert and Kalli Kappel . Former undergrad researcher Vedran Markota is now a graduate student in Biomedicine at the Karolinska Institute. Former high school researcher Kyra Wu is now at Cambridge University in the PhD program for Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology. February 2026 Former undergraduate researcher Aishwarya Venkatramani received her PhD in Biotechnology from Cambridge University in 2025 and is now a Postdoctoral Fellow at Cambridge. Former undergraduate researcher Yibei Jiang received her PhD in computational biochemistry from USC in 2025 and is now a Bioinformatics Support Scientist at Illumina. January 2026 Yuhang Zhu has joined the group as a new PhD student, primarily mentored by Rommie Amaro. Former postdoc Anthony Ivetac is now Executive Director, Head of Computational Sciences at Iambic Therapeutics, San Diego Former postdoc Sara (Nichols) Swift is now Director, Computational Drug Design at Vertex Pharmaceuticals. Former postdoc Andrew Gillette, co-mentored with Mike Holst, is now Computational Scientist, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory. November 2025 Former postdoc Fiona Kearns, jointly with Rommie Amaro’s group, is now a Tenure-track Junior Professor at the University of Freiburg, Germany Former postdoc Valentina Tozzini is now Research Director at CNR-Istituto Nanoscienze, Scuola Normale Superiore, Pisa. Former graduate student Mehrnoosh Arrar has won the worldwide L’Oréal-UNESCO junior prize“ for women in science", 2025 https://www.conicet.gov.ar Former postdoc Riccardo Baron is now Vice President of Artificial Intelligence at Codoxo, the leading provider of artificial intelligence solutions for healthcare management. October 2025 Former postdoc Jeff Wereszczynski is now Professor of Physics and Biology, Illinois Institute of Technology. Former postdoc Yi Wang is now Professor of Physics, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong. Former postdoc Ari Stern, co-mentored with Mike Holst, is now Professor of Mathematics, Washington University at St. Louis. Former graduate student Sylvia Tara is now Vice President of Product Development at Telix Pharmaceuticals. Former graduate student Nathan Baker is now Head of Partnerships for Chemistry and Materials, Microsoft Quantum. Former graduate student Burak Aksoylu, co-mentored with Mike Holst, is now Professor of Mathematics, Texas A&M University-San Antonio. Former graduate student Alex Perryman is now Principal Scientist at Variational AI in Vancouver. Former graduate student Jessica Swanson is now Associate Professor of Chemistry, University of Utah. Former graduate student Rob Swift is now Senior Expert II, Data Science at Novartis. Former graduate student Morgan Lawrenz is now Senior Principal Scientist at Schrodinger. September 2025 Former postdoc Jack Tanner has been awarded the endowed Curators’ Distinguished Professorship in Biochemistry and Chemistry, University of Missouri - Columbia. Former undergraduate Kalli Kappel is now Assistant Professor of Chemistry & Biochemistry, UCLA. Former postdoc Steffen Lindert is now Associate Professor of Chemistry, UCLA. August 2025 Fiona Kearns, a postdoc in Rommie Amaro’s group and jointly in ours, has accepted an Assistant Professorship in the Institute of Physical Chemistry at the University of Freiburg. Former postdoc Donald Hamelberg is now Distinguished Professor of Chemistry and Vice President for Research and Economic Development at Georgia State University. Former postdoc Chia-en Chang is now Full Professor of Chemistry at UC Riverside. Former postdoc Mike Gilson, Professor and Chair in Computer-Aided Drug Design at the Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences at UCSD, has won the 2026 American Chemical Society National Award for Computers in Chemical and Pharmaceutical Research. July 2025 Christian Seitz, a former graduate student in our lab and Rommie Amaro’s, has been awarded a prestigious NIH postdoctoral fellowship in the new Research on Emerging Areas Critical to Human Health program. Christian is currently a postdoc at U. Chicago and Argonne. Former graduate student Jacob Durrant, now on the faculty of the University of Pittsburgh, has developed a package for computer-aided drug discovery that has relatively modest computational requirements. More information and free access at https://moloda.org May 2025 Aleksandra Walczak, a former graduate student visitor and subsequent student with Jan Antosiewicz (MS) and at UCSD with Peter Wolynes (PhD), has been elected to the US National Academy of Sciences. Aleksandra is currently at the Ecole Normale Supérieure, Paris. Fiona Kearns, a postdoc in Rommie Amaro’s group and ours, will start a Junior Faculty position in the Department of Chemistry at the University of Freiburg. Our former postdoc Joe Dzubiella is also at Freiburg, as Professor of Theoretical Physics. April 2025 Former high school research participant Kyra Wu will complete her UCSD Bachelor of Science in Chemistry with a minor in Engineering Mechanics in June, and has accepted a fully-funded offer in the Biotechnology graduate program in Cambridge University’s Department of Chemical Engineering. Former postdoc Richard Law, DPhil Oxford, is returning to La Jolla as Chief Business Officer of HAYA Therapeutics. March 2025 Former postdoc Yanxiang Zhao is now Associate Professor and Deputy Chair of Mathematics, George Washington University, Washington DC. February 2025 Former postdoc Ari Stern is now Professor of Mathematics, Washington University in St. Louis. Former postdoc Ryosuke Ishizuka is now the Technology Manager at Nippon Shokuba Co., Osaka. January 2025 Former graduate student John Mongan is now Professor of Radiology and Director of the Center for Intelligent Imaging at UC San Francisco. Former graduate student Aslihan Iliyaz has completed her Ph.D. at the University of Copenhagen, and is now a postdoc at Schrodinger. Former postdoc Chia-En Chang, Professor of Chemistry at UC Riverside, is now Vice-Chair of her department. Former undergraduate researcher Peter Man-Un Ung is now Principal Scientist, Genentech. Former undergrad researcher Shayri Greenwood is now Science Department Chair at Friends Seminary, NYC. November 2024 Former undergrad researcher Gregory Sims is now Director of Bioinformatics, Turning Point Therapeutics. Former undergrad researcher Gergely Gidofalvi is now Associate Professor of Chemistry & Biochemistry at Gonzaga University. Former undergrad researcher Christine Gould is now Senior Scientific Director at Nucleus Global, San Francisco. October 2024 Former undergraduate researcher Paul Clemons is now Head, Data Engineering and Data Science, Arena BioWorks, Cambridge, Mass. He was previously Director, Computational Chemical Biology Research at the Broad Institute in Cambridge. Former undergrad researcher Eric Hom is now Associate Professor of Biology at the University of Mississippi. Former undergrad researcher Barry Smith is now Associate Professor of Mathematics at Lebanon Valley College, Pennsylvania. September 2024 Former undergraduate Aishwarya “Aish” Venkatramani, a current PhD student at Cambridge University, has been awarded a prestigious Harvey Fellowship. August 2024 Former postdoc Sanjib Senapati is now Head of the Department of Biotechnology, Indian Institute of Technology, Madras. Former postdoc Federico Fogolari has been promoted to Professor of Applied Science, University of Udine, Italy. Former postdoc Elaine Thompson is now Vice President of Bioinformatics at Embleema. Former postdoc Sarah Williams has been promoted to Director, Computer Aided Drug Discovery at Ventus Therapeutics. July 2024 Former grad student Marcus Hock, co-mentored with Prof. Andrew McCulloch, successfully defended his PhD thesis in Bioengineering. Former grad student Christopher Lee, co-mentored with Prof. Rommie Amaro, has accepted an Assistant Professorship in Molecular Biology in the School of Biological Sciences at UCSD. Former grad student Bill Sinko has been recruited as Director, Head of Computational Chemistry at Alivexis, Inc. Boston, MA. Former postdoc Maciej Baginski has been promoted to Professor of Pharmaceutical Technology and Biochemistry, Technical University of Gdansk, Poland. June 2024 Kyra Wu, an undergraduate associated with our group, won the Joe Watson Undergraduate Excellence Award from the Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry. Alisha Caliman, a former graduate student in our group, has been recruited as Principal Scientist, Computational Chemist, Kymera Therapeutics. April 2024 Former Postdoc Giulia Palermo, Associate Professor of Engineering and Chemistry at University of California, Riverside, has received a Camille Dreyfus Teacher-Scholar Award. Former postdoc Willy Wriggers, Frank Batten Chair of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering and Bioengineering at Old Dominion University, has received the ODU Eminent Scholar Award. March 2024 Former postdoc Barry Grant has been promoted to Teaching Professor of Molecular Biology in the Division of Biological Sciences, UCSD. Former graduate student David Minh has been appointed to the Robert E. Frey Endowed Chair in Chemistry at Illinois Institute of Technology. Former Postdoc Shenggao Zhou has been promoted to Professor, School of Mathematical Sciences, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Former graduate student Kate (Rogers) Standish is now Senior Regional Medical Scientific Director, Oncology at Merck Research Labs. February 2024 Former postdoc Giulia Palermo, now Associate Professor, University of California at Riverside, gave the 2023 Early Career Award Winner lecture for the Theory and Computational Subgroup at the national meeting of the Biophysical Society. Former graduate student Jessica Swanson, now Assistant Professor, University of Utah, also gave a lecture in this Biophysical Society program Jessica Swanson has also been named recipient of the prestigious Cottrell Scholar Award, which provides support for a three-year term. Former postdoc Xiaolin Cheng has been promoted to Professor, School of Pharmacy, The Ohio State University. Former postdoc Steffen Lindert has been promoted to Associate Professor of Chemistry, The Ohio State University. Former postdoc David Zhang is now Vice President, Head of Protein Engineering, MoleculeMind, Beijing. Former postdoc Riccardo Baron is now Director - Executive Advisor, AI Analytics, CVS Health. January 2024 Former postdoc Yanxiang Zhao is now Associate Professor of Mathematics, George Washington University. Former postdoc Denis Bucher is now Principal Scientist/Computational Chemist at LifeMine Therapeutics. Basel, Switzerland. November 2023 Former graduate student William Sinko has been promoted to Director, Head of Computational Chemistry at Modulus Discovery. Former postdoc John Moody (joint with Mike Holst’s group) has been promoted to Director of Operations Research, Viasat Inc. September 2023 Anson Noland will be co-advised in his Ph.D. with Prof. Rommie Amaro Anupam Anand Ojha will also be co-advised in his PhD with Rommie Amaro Former graduate student Christian Seitz is now a postdoc in Computer Science at the University of Chicago and Argonne National Laboratory. August 2023 Former graduate student Alisha Caliman is now Principal Scientist, Computational Chemistry, Kymera Therapeutics, Watertown, MA July 2023 Former postdoc Jim Briggs, Professor of Biochemistry at University of Houston, has been named the University’s Associate Provost for Faculty Development and Faculty Affairs, starting July 1. Welcome Praharshitha Thumati – a new undergraduate researcher in our group. June 2023 Current postdoc Wen Ma has accepted the position of Assistant Professor of Physics at the University of Vermont. He will start at Vermont in January. Former postdoc Yinglong Miao has been recruited to the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill as Associate Professor of Pharmacology. Former postdoc Jeremy Kua is now Full Professor of Chemistry at the University of San Diego. Former postdoc Zeyun Yu is now Full Professor of Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering, University of Wisconsin, Milwaukee. Former postdoc Yunrong Zhu is now Full Professor of Mathematics at Idaho State University. Former graduate student Nathan Baker is now Senior Director, Partnerships for Chemistry and Materials -- Microsoft. May 2023 Welcome Chloe Chen – a new undergraduate researcher in our group. Donald Hamelberg is now Associate Dean for Research, Innovation and Graduate Studies, College of Arts and Sciences, Georgia State University. Dave Cerutti is now Scientific Engineer, High-Performance Computing, Psivant Therapeutics, Boston. March 2023 Former postdoc Sarah Williams is now Associate Director, Computer Aided Drug Discovery at Ventus Therapeutics. February 2023 Graduate student Christian Seitz has accepted a postdoctoral position at the University of Chicago and Argonne National Lab. Former graduate student Terra Sztain has been offered an Assistant Professorship of Medicinal Chemistry and Chemistry at the University of Michigan – Ann Arbor. Former postdoc Giulia Palermo, now on the faculty of UC Riverside, has been awarded a prestigious Sloan Research Fellowship. January 2023 Our Science Advances paper with Julian Schroeder’s group reveals how plants respond to carbon dioxide and conserve water, important factors in climate science. A news release about the paper is at https://today.ucsd.edu Former grad student in our group and Rommie Amaro’s, Ben Jagger, is now Principal Scientist, Computation, at Evercrisp Biosciences in Berkeley. November 2022 Christian Seitz, a graduate student co-mentored with Rommie Amaro, successfully defended his Ph.D. on Nov. 14. Christian ALSO won the Chemical Computing Group Excellence Award for the Spring 2023 ACS national meeting. Andy McCammon was awarded the Revelle Medal , UCSD’s highest honor for faculty members. Former postdoc Peter M. Kekenes-Huskey was named Senior Scientist of the Year at Loyola University, Chicago, where he is Associate Professor of Cell and Molecular Physiology. Former graduate student Dan Mermelstein is now computational software engineer at Pfizer, La Jolla. October 2022 Former postdoc Giulia Palermo (Assoc. Prof., UC Riverside) has won the American Chemical Society’s 2022 WCC Rising Star Award for excellence in the scientific enterprise. This Award is sponsored by The Women Chemists Committee of the ACS. Giulia has ALSO won the NERSC High Performance Computing Achievement Award from the DOE Berkeley Lab. Former graduate student Jacob Durrant has received tenure and promotion to Associate Professor of Biological Sciences at the University of Pittsburgh. Former postdoc Yongcheng Zhou is now Full Professor of Mathematics at Colorado State University. September 2022 Former postdoc Giulia Palermo has been promoted to Associate Professor with tenure in Bioengineering and Chemistry at the University of California Riverside. She will also receive the Biophysical Society’s Theory and Computation Subgroup Early Career Award for 2023. Former postdoc Ferran Feixas has received the prestigious “Ramon y Cajal" Award from the Spanish Ministry of Science, leading to a tenured faculty position at the University of Girona, Spain. Former graduate student Olivia Kim Pierce is now Principal Scientist, CADD, Bristol Myers Squibb. Former postdoc Elaine Thompson is now Vice President, Bioinformatics, Embleema, Inc. August 2022 Nature has published our paper on the astonishing nucleus-like structure discovered in a bacteriophage in its August 3 issue. July 2022 Ben Jagger, a former graduate student in Rommie Amaro’s group and ours, is now Principal Scientist at Evercr
